title: Hillcrest Leisure Centre: Notices for Members
body_html:
Text A — Swimming pool: changes to the timetable

From Monday 4 November, the main pool will close at 7.00 p.m. instead of 9.00 p.m. every Tuesday so that essential maintenance can be carried out. Lane swimming, which currently takes place on weekday evenings, will move to weekday mornings and will run from 6.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m. Children's swimming lessons will transfer from Saturday afternoons to Sunday mornings; parents will receive an email confirming their child's new lesson time.

Please note that the small teaching pool will be closed for two weeks from 11 November for retiling. While it is closed, members may swim free of charge at our partner site, Eastgate Baths, simply by showing their Hillcrest membership card at reception.

Text B — New autumn fitness classes

This autumn we are delighted to launch three new classes.

Beginners' Pilates — Mondays at 7.00 p.m. (45 minutes). £6 per class, or £48 for the full ten-week course.

Aqua Fitness — Wednesdays at 9.30 a.m. Free for Gold members; £5 for all other members.

Teen Circuit Training — Fridays at 5.00 p.m., for ages 13 to 17. The first session is free.

Places are limited to 15 per class, so early booking is advised — book online or at reception. Please wear comfortable clothing and bring a water bottle to every class. A class will be cancelled if fewer than six people have booked by the day before.

Text C — Lockers, towels and lost property

Lockers are available in all changing rooms and require a £1 coin, which is returned when you collect your belongings. The centre cannot accept responsibility for valuables left in the changing rooms, so please leave them at home if possible. Towels may be hired at reception for £2, with a £5 deposit payable at the time of hire.

Items found in the building are kept in our lost property cupboard for four weeks; anything unclaimed after that time is donated to a local charity shop. Items of obvious value, such as phones, wallets and jewellery, are handed to the duty manager and recorded in a log book.

groups.prompt: Questions 1–5. Do the following statements agree with the information given in Texts A–C?
groups.instructions_html: Write TRUE if the statement agrees with the information, FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

questions.prompt_text: Lane swimming will be available on weekday mornings.
questions.evidence: Text A states that lane swimming will move to weekday mornings and run from 6.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m., so the statement agrees with the notice.

questions.prompt_text: Children's swimming lessons will move to Saturday mornings.
questions.evidence: Text A says lessons will transfer from Saturday afternoons to Sunday mornings, not Saturday mornings, so the statement contradicts the text.

questions.prompt_text: Members will have to pay to swim at Eastgate Baths while the teaching pool is closed.
questions.evidence: Text A says members may swim free of charge at Eastgate Baths by showing their membership card, so no payment is needed.

questions.prompt_text: Eastgate Baths has a larger pool than Hillcrest Leisure Centre.
questions.evidence: Eastgate Baths is only mentioned as a partner site where members can swim; nothing is said about the size of its pool.

questions.prompt_text: A class will not run if fewer than six people have booked.
questions.evidence: Text B states that a class will be cancelled if fewer than six people have booked by the day before.

groups.instructions_html: Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the texts for each answer.

questions.prompt_text: The small teaching pool will be closed for two weeks for ______.
questions.evidence: Text A says the small teaching pool will be closed for two weeks from 11 November for retiling.

questions.prompt_text: A place on the full ten-week Pilates course costs £______.
questions.evidence: Text B gives the price of Beginners' Pilates as £6 per class or £48 for the full ten-week course.

questions.prompt_text: The first session of Teen Circuit Training is ______.
questions.evidence: Text B states that the first session of Teen Circuit Training is free.

questions.prompt_text: No more than ______ people can attend each class.
questions.evidence: Text B says places are limited to 15 per class, so 15 is the maximum number of people.

questions.prompt_text: Everyone attending a class should wear comfortable clothing and bring a ______.
questions.evidence: Text B asks participants to wear comfortable clothing and bring a water bottle to every class.

groups.instructions_html: Choose NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER from the texts for each answer.

questions.prompt_text: What coin is needed to use a locker?
questions.evidence: Text C explains that lockers require a £1 coin, which is returned when you collect your belongings.

questions.prompt_text: How much is the deposit for hiring a towel?
questions.evidence: Text C says towels may be hired for £2 with a £5 deposit payable at the time of hire; the deposit is £5.

questions.prompt_text: How long is lost property kept before it is given to charity?
questions.evidence: Text C states that found items are kept in the lost property cupboard for four weeks, after which unclaimed items are donated to a charity shop.

questions.prompt_text: Who are valuable found items given to?
questions.evidence: Text C says items of obvious value are handed to the duty manager and recorded in a log book.

title: What's On in Millbrook: Three Local Notices
body_html:
Text A — Millbrook Lantern Festival

Saturday 19 October, Riverside Park, 4.00 p.m. – 9.00 p.m.

Join us for the town's favourite autumn event! A lantern-making workshop will be held at the library at 2.00 p.m.; booking is essential, all materials are provided, and the cost is £3 per child (accompanying adults free). The lantern parade leaves the library at 6.30 p.m. and makes its way through the town to the park.

Hot food and drinks will be on sale — please note that the food stalls accept cash only. There is no parking at Riverside Park; instead, a free shuttle bus runs from the railway station every 15 minutes throughout the evening. Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a lead. The evening ends with a firework display at 8.45 p.m., which will be cancelled in the event of heavy rain.

Text B — Millbrook Farmers' Market

Because the Town Square is being repaved, the weekly farmers' market is moving to Memorial Gardens from 1 September. As usual, the market runs every Saturday from 8.00 a.m. to 1.00 p.m., with more than forty stalls selling local cheese, bread, vegetables and flowers. On the first Saturday of every month the market also hosts a craft fair.

Shoppers are asked to bring their own bags, as stallholders no longer provide plastic ones. Are you under 18 and growing your own fruit or vegetables? Our free 'young grower' stall lets you sell your home-grown produce at no charge — apply to the market manager for details.

Text C — Changes to bus route 46

From Monday 23 September, route 46 buses will no longer stop at Mill Lane, owing to roadworks that are expected to last six weeks. A temporary stop has been set up on Bridge Street, two minutes' walk away. In addition, evening services after 8.00 p.m. will run every hour rather than every thirty minutes. The Sunday timetable is unchanged. Up-to-date departure times can be found on the operator's website and phone app. Ticket prices are not affected by these changes.
